selection_protocol: Minimum recorded validation loss only; no test result used.
step_note: W&B epoch validation logs have trainer/global_step = checkpoint global_step - 1. Training logs continue into epoch 18 after last.ckpt epoch 17; those later updates are not in last.ckpt. Callback current_score can remain from an older top-k update and is not the latest validation loss.

validation_protocol.aggregation: Lightning averages logged batch scalars using CAD batch_size; adjacency precision/recall are averages of batch ratios, not pooled counts.

test_protocol_cautions: VAE test_step explicitly sets v_test=True and uses posterior mean; test loss is not expected to numerically match stochastic validation loss.
Explicit dataset.is_aug=0 is needed for one canonical reconstruction per CAD; inherited is_aug=1 expands testing to 24 cube rotations.
Use one GPU for exported full-test evaluation to avoid distributed sampler duplicates.
This is a fine-tune initialized from legacy weights; epoch 0 means after 363 optimizer steps, not an untrained or original baseline.
interpretation_zh: 验证总损失确实已进入窄幅波动区间：前3轮均值0.040988，末3轮0.040253，仅下降1.79%；最近8轮未突破epoch 10的最好值，线性趋势也没有下降。不能据此证明继续训练绝无收益。
训练epoch均值仍缓慢下降，但验证几何总体接近持平；边面贴合没有出现稳定改善，twin和分类有小幅改善。
edge_feature teacher matching约占验证总损失47%；total变化不能替代最终几何和solid有效性判断。
同一checkpoint内，coarse与refined的局部几何/bbox差异大多低于0.5%；残差幅度增加不等于几何改善。此比较不能代替新模型和原legacy模型的公平对比。
冻结encoder与posterior并未关闭posterior采样；验证每次仍有随机扰动。正式test是mean重建，需独立报告。
